description:
Sleep Music | Drift Off Effortlessly | 1.5 Hours Bansuri

Some nights the tiredness is there but the sleep isn't.

You lie down. The room is quiet. But something is still running — the day replaying itself, the next one already loading. You don't need more effort. You just need something to carry you the rest of the way down.

This is 90 minutes of slow Bansuri in Raga Darbari Kanada. Darbari is a deep-midnight raga — its phrases are slow, heavy, serious in a way that doesn't feel heavy to listen to. The bamboo flute carries it with breath-driven warmth. Nothing sharp, nothing urgent. Just sound that deepens the way the night deepens when you finally stop resisting it.

A gentle Delta wave layer sits underneath at very low volume — not there to do anything dramatic, just to keep the body moving in the direction of sleep.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Bansuri — warm bamboo flute, breath-driven, unhurried
- Sparse phrases with long natural silences between them
- Very slow tempo — the music breathes slower than you will
- A barely-there low-frequency Delta layer underneath
- 90 unbroken minutes — no startling fade-outs

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Settling in
20:00  First heaviness
45:00  Mind letting go
70:00  Deep sleep zone
85:00  Peaceful close

🧠 How to use:
Press play before you're fully tired. Phone face-down, volume low but audible. Don't try — just let the Bansuri set the pace. You'll catch up to it.

⏱ Best for:
• Mind that won't stop at night
• Trouble falling asleep
• 1am to 4am wakeups
• Gentle wind-down before bed
• Background for deep rest

thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature painting style, ornate deep-indigo-and-gold patterned border with subtle crescent moon and night-bloom motifs, aged warm parchment background, deep-night palette (midnight indigo fading to soft black, single oil lamp glow casting warm amber light). Central figure: serene musician in deep-blue-and-cream attire seated on a low woven mat playing bansuri (long bamboo flute held horizontally to lips) in a quiet open-air night courtyard. Moonlight above, a single lotus pool catching the light. Scene is very still — no wind, no movement, just deep quiet. Bold dark-teal serif overlay text reading 'FALL ASLEEP' top-center, traditional Devanagari-influenced serif typography, high contrast for mobile readability. Midnight-indigo and warm amber palette, deep still night mood, single composed scene, no clutter.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Slow bansuri solo in raga Darbari Kanada, deep midnight sleep mood, very sparse breath-driven melodic flow with extremely long sustained notes and long silences between phrases, no percussion, no tabla, 432Hz tuning, 40-50 BPM very slow dreamy tempo, deep low-mid register (warm and heavy, not bright or high-pitched), cinematic deeply meditative production, hypnotic and grounding, suitable for extended looping in post-production, begins immediately with bansuri already playing at low volume, full sonic presence from first note. CRITICAL: Darbari Kanada uses komal Ga, komal Dha, komal Ni — the flat intervals give it natural weight and gravity. Emotionally: like consciousness sinking through layers — not dramatic, just inevitable. Very long meends (glides between notes). 10-15 seconds of near-silence between phrases is correct. Delta wave layer at -22dB barely audible underneath. Bansuri mid-LOW register only — high bansuri is alerting not sleep-inducing.

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: Raga Darbari Kanada — deep midnight raga. Sa Re Ga(komal) Ma Pa Dha(komal) Ni(komal) Sa. The komal (flat) intervals create its characteristic heaviness. CRITICAL: First Suno clip must feel genuinely drowsy in low-mid register before extending — if clip sounds bright or fast, regenerate. EMOTIONAL TAG ROTATION: clip 1: 'like consciousness sinking — heavy and inevitable' · clip 2: 'still and deep, like the middle of a silent night' · clip 3: 'like the last thought before sleep, fading'. Mix: Bansuri -3dB, Binaural -22dB (barely audible), LUFS -16dB (sleep audience). 90min = 3-4 Suno clips + loop extension in post.
